title: Widgets
html:
When you sign in to the program, the home page appears, where information bars and widgets are displayed depending on your permission level.

The widgets support daily work according to individual needs and the permission system. By default they may contain the following:

  • Overdue supplier and customer invoices

  • Unfinished sales left open

  • Products below the minimum stock level

  • Stock waiting to be loaded

  • Documents waiting for approval

  • Vehicles with an expiring registration certificate

  • Automatic e-mail sending errors

  • Bank and cash desk balances

  • VAT, sales information, receivables, payables

  • HR widgets

  • Other information related to financial transactions

These information panels can be extended further according to individual needs. Clicking any row of the information bar opens the related document.

For customer invoices — if an e-mail address is recorded for the partner — clicking the e-mail icon sends an immediate payment reminder to the partner, or you can view the overdue invoice.
